name: ever-gauzy
description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
one_liner: A free, all-in-one business back-office system covering HR, time tracking, sales CRM, invoicing, and project management in one app you run yourself.
buyer: A small agency or consultancy owner who's outgrown spreadsheets but doesn't want to pay for five separate SaaS subscriptions (HR tool + CRM + PM tool + invoicing).
business_use_cases: A staffing/outsourcing agency uses its built-in time tracking and invoicing to bill clients per tracked hour without buying Toggl and QuickBooks separately.
A boutique dev shop runs its whole sales pipeline, project boards, and employee time tracking from one self-hosted system to cut recurring SaaS costs.
An IT consultant offers 'we'll host and customize Gauzy for your business' as a productized service to small businesses avoiding SaaS fees.

money_ideas.idea: Offer done-for-you hosting, setup, and customization for small businesses
Build and sell premium plugins/integrations (payroll, tax, industry-specific modules) on top of the open core

steal_this: Deploy a hosted instance this weekend, customize the branding for one specific niche (e.g. freelance agencies), and offer it as a $49/mo 'ops-in-a-box' alternative to stitching five SaaS tools together.
